scope.target: Issue #194 long-running validation delegation and no-polling governance
constraints: Keep canonical aggregate validation and fail-closed outcomes
Classify release, nightly-full, full-matrix, and at-least-120-second commands as long-running
Dispatch only after focused validation and a clean immutable commit
Use the least expensive capable external task and prohibit primary-conversation polling
Require schema-valid dispatch and completion envelopes with an explicit or runtime-injected source-task identity
Allow a source-task callback or one parent event wait, with one terminal read-back only after callback transport failure
Apply terminal-only progress delivery to the source task while leaving runtime-local commentary to the delegated runtime
Keep execution timeout, interruption, subject drift, missing terminal evidence, and blocked execution non-passing while treating parent wait timeout as pending
Do not enable parallel aggregate execution without dependency and artifact-isolation contract evidence
non_goals: Remove check-all or weaken selected validation
Repair validation failures inside the external task
Create a v0.13 tag, Release, or publication
Close Issues or mutate Project fields

steps: Record Issue #194 authority and current failed/terminated execution receipts
Add canonical and machine-readable long-running validation rules
Add deterministic contract coverage and run focused validators
Dispatch one focused regression command with the canonical prompt envelope and verify one callback or event-wait terminal report
Hand the fixed branch back to the source owner for the separately governed hosted PR integration gate
